findings.title: Per-user OAuth 2.0 authorization with page picker and access token

findings.title: Read content capability for reading shared page titles and content
findings.detail: The Read content capability lets a connection read existing content. Reading a page or its blocks requires read content capabilities. Access to a page also extends to its child pages, and missing capabilities return 403.
findings.appliesWhen: Reading shared page titles and block content; no create, update, or insert capability is requested.

evidence.quote: * **Read content**: This capability gives a connection access to read existing content in a Notion workspace. For example, a connection with only this capability is able to call Retrieve
> [!NOTE] > > **If a connection is added to a page, then the connection can access the page’s children**
## Errors The connection needs read content capabilities. Missing capabilities return `403`. A missing page or missing access returns `404`.

findings.title: Public integration required for installation in other workspaces
findings.detail: A scoped integration can be installed only in workspaces selected at creation and cannot be listed on the Marketplace. Installation in any workspace requires a public integration. Installation scope cannot be changed after creation.
findings.appliesWhen: Other customer organizations or workspaces will connect the app.

steps.title: Read a shared page's title and properties
steps.detail: Retrieve a page the customer shared with the connection. The page title is in the title property of the page properties object. Expected output: a page object whose title property holds the page title text.
steps.doneWhen: The response is HTTP 200 and the page title text is extracted from the title property. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.

evidence.quote: Response JSON paths for GET /v1/pages/{page_id}: $.properties.*.title[].plain_text (string)
## GET /v1/pages/{page_id} | Retrieve a page
Parameter Notion-Version in header (unspecified type, required): The API version to use for this request. The latest version is `2026-03-11`. Schema: {"enum":["2026-03-11"]}

fields: PAGE_ID: a page the customer shared with the connection
ACCESS_TOKEN: access_token from the token exchange response

steps.title: Read the shared page's content as markdown
steps.detail: Retrieve the full page content as Notion-flavored markdown. If truncated is true, pass each unknown_block_ids entry back to the same endpoint. Treat object_not_found for an unknown block as an inaccessible subtree and report it rather than retrying indefinitely.
steps.doneWhen: The markdown string is read with truncated false, or every returned unknown block ID is fetched or reported as inaccessible. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.

fields: PAGE_ID: the same shared page as the metadata read

steps.doneWhen: Each unknown block ID returns markdown content or an object_not_found error that is recorded as inaccessible.
